messages:
Amelia: Customer acme.ai just escalated — huge spike in Embeddings on Console last night, they got billed for it. They say their API traffic didn’t change. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/acme/embeds-spike.png

support-bot: New ticket created TKT-4321 and assigned to @Amelia :white_check_mark:

Amelia: attaching invoice snippet and the dashboard chart (compare tokens vs vectors): https://files.redwood/acme/invoice-0326.pdf — they claim the UI is showing tokens as vectors and counts look ~10x API calls

Raj: pinging eng-metrics — can you pull raw embedding events for customer_id=acme-123 between 2026-03-16T22:00 and 2026-03-16T23:30? Suspect ingestion duplicates.

Lorenzo: FYI we pushed a dashboard aggregation tweak yesterday that multiplies `vector_count` by `token_estimate` in the recent rollup. That was intended for cost preview, but might have accidentally been used in the main UI. I’ll query the raw table now.

Amelia: customer provided repro: they batch 3 inputs in one call to /v1/embeddings every 10s for an hour. API logs show 3 vectors per request. Console shows ~9 vectors per request in that window. Payload example they sent: `["summary a","summary b","summary c"]`

Raj: suggested SQL to run in analytics-prod: `SELECT event_id, request_id, customer_id, unit_type, unit_count, ts FROM embedding_events WHERE customer_id='acme-123' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-16T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-16T23:30:00Z' ORDER BY ts LIMIT 100;`

Lorenzo: ran a quick extract — seeing many rows with identical `event_id` but different `ingestion_id` and identical `request_id`. Ingestion retries during a transient 429 window seem to have reinserted events rather than deduping.

Maria (Billing): note that billing ledger consumes `analytics.rollups.units` as "billing units". If the rollup changed semantics (tokens vs vectors), customers can be billed incorrectly. We need to find which system fed the ledger for that billing period.

Raj: checked ingestion logs — at 2026-03-16T22:07:12Z the ingestion cluster returned 429s for a portion of batches; the client retried and our pipeline used `insert_many` without a unique index on `event_id`. Hotfix plan: add unique index + idempotent upsert on event_id at ingestion point. I’ll open a PR.

Amelia: customer asked for repro script so they can validate. Shared quick python snippet they used:```python
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer REDACTED"}
data = {"input": ["a","b","c"]}
r = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers)
print(r.status_code, r.json())
# then check Console -> Usage -> Embeddings and compare counts
```

Raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/analytics/pull/284 — adds unique index on `event_id` in Mongo, switches ingestion to `updateOne({event_id}, {$setOnInsert: doc}, {upsert: true})`. Will deploy hotfix to ingestion cluster.

Lorenzo: also reversing the recent dashboard aggregation change for the public UI until we have explicit unit labels. We’ll expose a toggle: show as `vectors` or `tokens` and a clear note about billing mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/910

Maria (Billing): I’ll prepare a pro-rata credit for acme.ai for the affected window (2026-03-16T22:00 to 2026-03-16T23:30). Need final duplicate count from eng to compute dollar amount.

Amelia: forwarding this plan to the customer. They asked for ETA on fix and credits. ETA requested: hotfix + backfill within 2 business hours.

eng-oncall-bot: Hotfix deployed to ingestion-prod at 2026-03-17T01:12Z :shipit: Rolling window dedupe monitoring enabled.

Raj: after deployment we deduped ~12,348 duplicate events for acme-123. Removed duplicates from rollups and re-ran rollup job for that hour.

Lorenzo: dashboard reverted to vectors view and numbers now match API call counts. Also added explicit unit labels and a tooltip explaining billing mapping.

Maria (Billing): computed credit amount and issued invoice adjustment; customer account credited.

Amelia: Customer confirmed counts match API and credits applied. They’re closing the ticket. Thanks team! :tada:

Lorenzo: follow-ups — add an automated test to ingestion that simulates transient 429s and retries to ensure no duplicates reinserted, and add a dashboard unit toggle e2e test.

Raj: filing a postmortem note in #postmortems with root cause: ingestion retry + missing uniqueness constraint + recent aggregation change caused UI confusion -> billing impact.

Amelia: closing TKT-4321. Will add short customer-facing summary in the support ticket and link to billing memo.

Maria (Billing): nice work. :thumbsup:

Amelia: Thank you all.
